declare @q nvarchar(4000), @unit varchar(33) select @unit = case when @$ma_dvcs = '' then @@unit else @$ma_dvcs end
select top 0 '' as array$, ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, t_so_luong, t_tt into #data from m81$000000
set @q = 'insert into #data select '''', ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, t_so_luong, t_tt from m81$%Partition where %[ma_nt = ''' + rtrim(@$ma_nt) + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + rtrim(@$ma_kh) + ''' and tk = ''' + rtrim(@$tk) + ''' and ma_gd in (''8'', ''9'') and xu_ly <> ''3'' and status = ''2'']%' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @unit, 'ngay_ct', @$ngay_ct0, @$ngay_ct2, @@userID, @@admin select * from #data order by ngay_ct, so_ct return
